items.title: 67520_George Handy oral history interview
items.q: I met Les, I used to go out jamming with him in the early Herbie Fields days

ctx.x: I don't think it was much before 1955.

I'm sure it was. I heard about Les doing that--I met Les, I used to go out jamming with him in the early Herbie Fields days, we used to go out to these black clubs in Brooklyn and play, and I'd say within ten years after that I heard about him doing things in his own studio, within ten years--fifteen tops. That would put it close to those days, a few years before. I would say it would put it 1950.
I'm not sure I wouldn't argue that, but this is not the appropriate place.
